plugins.name: yolo-dag
plugins.description: Turns an ambiguous request into a reviewed, executed, integrated branch: /brainstorm resolves ambiguity, then the orchestrator routes to the relevant specialists, runs per-specialist review loops, reconciles cross-specialist contradictions, decomposes into a task DAG, executes it with a ready-queue that merges each passing task onto one integration branch as it lands, and closes with a whole-suite run and an acceptance review against the original request.
